# VirtualFileSystemMountType

The kind of run a file system is mounted into.

**Kind:** a string enum, used in responses.

## Values

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `"CapsuleProcess"` | A capsule run. |
| `"CodePipelineProcess"` | A code pipeline run. |

New values can appear, so treat one you don't know as "something else", not as an error.

## Where it's used

- Inside [`VirtualFileSystemMount`](virtual-file-system-mount.md)
